description: Store packaged CLI skill assets in a managed ~/.mohist cache, keep them synchronized with installed CLI builds, and resolve mo skills commands from version-compatible assets with actionable diagnostics.

tasks.title: Add skill asset manifest support
tasks.description: Define the packaged skill-data manifest format and implement generation/validation helpers that record the running CLI build identity and bundled built-in skill names. Ensure publish output skill-data can be made self-describing before it is copied into the managed cache.
acceptanceCriteria: Generated skill-data contains manifest.json with at least a CLI version or git hash field and the bundled built-in skill names.
Manifest validation detects missing manifests, incompatible build identity, omitted built-in skill names, and missing SKILL.md files.
Manifest logic is reusable by CLI resolution, mo update synchronization, and install script verification without touching runtime/internal .mohist/skills.
tasks.output: Manifest generation and validation code for packaged skill-data assets.
tasks.notes: Use the existing CLI build identity source where available; if exact git hash availability is uncertain, make version the minimum compatibility field required by the spec.

tasks.title: Resolve managed skill asset roots
tasks.description: Update SkillAssetService root selection to prefer a valid MOHIST_SKILLS_DIR, then a version-compatible managed cache at ~/.mohist/cli/skill-data, then compatible AppContext.BaseDirectory/skill-data fallback assets. Centralize mismatch diagnostics so command handlers receive actionable resolver errors instead of raw missing-file failures.
acceptanceCriteria: MOHIST_SKILLS_DIR takes precedence when it points to a valid built-in skill asset root.
A compatible ~/.mohist/cli/skill-data cache is selected by default and mo skills path reports paths under that root.
Sibling AppContext.BaseDirectory/skill-data is selected only when no environment override is set and the managed cache is absent.
Missing, stale, incompatible, incomplete, or skill-omitting managed caches fail with repair guidance mentioning mo update or scripts/install-mo.sh.
Resolution does not read, write, scan, or mutate runtime/internal .mohist/skills.
tasks.output: Updated SkillAssetService resolver behavior and diagnostics.
tasks.notes: Per design, an incompatible existing managed cache should produce a diagnostic for installed use rather than silently falling back to sibling assets.

tasks.title: Serve mo skills commands from validated assets
tasks.description: Ensure mo skills list, get, get --full, get --all, path, and full packaged install modes consume the validated asset root returned by SkillAssetService. Preserve repository and Claude discovery-stub installs while keeping Hermes full-skill installs backed by packaged skill-data.
acceptanceCriteria: mo skills get mohist and mo skills get mohist-explore print full packaged guidance from the selected validated asset root.
mo skills get mohist --full appends packaged references and templates in deterministic sorted order.
mo skills list and mo skills list --json report visible built-in skills from packaged content without duplicate hidden discovery stubs.
mo skills path mohist reports ~/.mohist/cli/skill-data/mohist when the managed cache is selected.

mo skills install and mo skills install --claude continue installing lightweight discovery stubs, while --hermes copies full packaged built-in skills and supplementary files only for Mohist built-ins.
tasks.output: Updated mo skills command behavior backed by validated packaged assets.
tasks.notes: Keep user-authored skill directories and Hermes config.yaml untouched.

tasks.title: Synchronize assets during mo update
tasks.description: Update SourceCodeUpdater.UpdateCliAsync so mo update publishes the CLI, verifies publishDir/skill-data, installs the binary, and synchronizes packaged skill assets into ~/.mohist/cli/skill-data. Use a temporary directory and replace the managed root atomically enough to avoid observable half-updated assets.
acceptanceCriteria: mo update copies publish output skill-data, including manifest.json, mohist/SKILL.md, and mohist-explore/SKILL.md, into ~/.mohist/cli/skill-data.
Synchronization prepares assets in a temporary directory under ~/.mohist/cli before replacing the managed skill-data root.
After mo update, mo skills get mohist and mo skills get mohist-explore work without MOHIST_SKILLS_DIR.
mo update refreshes only the managed packaged asset cache and does not modify user-authored skills or runtime/internal .mohist/skills.
tasks.notes: Keep synchronization scoped to the Mohist local state root's cli/skill-data cache.

tasks.title: Synchronize assets in install script
tasks.description: Update scripts/install-mo.sh so manual local installs copy the published mo binary and synchronize publish output skill-data into ~/.mohist/cli/skill-data using the same managed-cache semantics. Verify expected assets and manifest are present before replacing the managed directory.
acceptanceCriteria: scripts/install-mo.sh installs the mo binary and copies packaged skill-data into ~/.mohist/cli/skill-data.
The managed cache includes manifest.json and built-in mohist and mohist-explore SKILL.md files after install.
Subsequent mo skills path mohist reports the managed asset path when the managed cache is in use.
The script does not read, write, or mutate .mohist/skills, .agents/skills, .claude/skills, or .hermes/skills as part of cache synchronization.
tasks.notes: Shell implementation should mirror the code path closely enough for manual installs without adding a new mo skills update command.

tasks.title: Test resolver precedence and diagnostics
tasks.description: Add focused tests for SkillAssetService managed root resolution, environment override precedence, sibling fallback, manifest compatibility checks, and repair-guidance diagnostics. Include assertions that packaged asset management does not interact with runtime/internal .mohist/skills.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests cover default managed asset root resolution under ~/.mohist/cli/skill-data.
Tests cover MOHIST_SKILLS_DIR precedence over managed and sibling roots.
Tests cover sibling AppContext.BaseDirectory/skill-data fallback when the managed cache is absent.
Tests cover missing manifest, stale or incompatible manifest, omitted skill names, and missing SKILL.md diagnostics with repair guidance.
Tests verify runtime/internal .mohist/skills is not read, written, scanned, or mutated by packaged asset resolution.
tasks.output: Automated resolver and diagnostic test coverage.
tasks.notes: Prefer isolated temp directories and injectable path/build identity seams over mutating the real user home.

tasks.title: Test command behavior from managed assets
tasks.description: Add CLI behavior tests that exercise mo skills list, get, get --full, get --all, path, install, --claude, and --hermes against validated packaged assets. Verify installed discovery stubs load full managed guidance through mo skills get without requiring MOHIST_SKILLS_DIR.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests verify mo skills get mohist and mohist-explore return full packaged guidance from the managed cache.
Tests verify mo skills path mohist reports ~/.mohist/cli/skill-data/mohist when managed cache is selected.
Tests verify repository and Claude installs write discovery stubs, not full packaged guidance.
Tests verify Hermes install copies full packaged built-in guidance and supplementary references/templates while respecting HERMES_HOME.
Tests verify user-authored and unrelated skill directories remain untouched.
tasks.output: Automated mo skills command behavior test coverage.
tasks.notes: Use command-level tests where possible so discovery-stub and full-guidance behavior is product-observable.

tasks.title: Test update and install synchronization
tasks.description: Add tests for mo update and scripts/install-mo.sh asset synchronization paths, including manifest presence, atomic-enough replacement behavior, and post-install command usability. Cover stale managed cache replacement without touching runtime or external skill locations.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests verify SourceCodeUpdater.UpdateCliAsync synchronizes publishDir/skill-data into ~/.mohist/cli/skill-data with manifest and built-in skills.
Tests verify scripts/install-mo.sh synchronizes packaged skill-data into the managed cache during manual install.
Tests verify stale managed cache contents are replaced by current publish output.
Tests verify post-update or post-install mo skills get/path works without MOHIST_SKILLS_DIR.
Tests verify update and install synchronization do not mutate runtime/internal .mohist/skills or external agent skill directories.
tasks.notes: Script tests may execute against a temp HOME and temp install prefix to avoid touching the developer machine.
